What if Slughorn had given Dumbledore his REAL memory about Voldemort’s Horcruxes from the very beginning? 

Today J dives into an alternate version of the Wizarding World of Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince where one honest confession could expose Draco’s plan, reveal Ravenclaw’s diadem, and change the fate of Ron, Ginny, Neville, and Dumbledore himself. Could telling the truth actually make everything worse?

What would Harry do with his Felix Felicis if he never needed it to persuade Slughorn? Let us know in the comments!
